title: Password
purpose: See whether your signed-in account has a password and change or set it.
summary: See whether your own account has a password, and change it. The change opens in a dialog over this page.

tasks.title: Change your password
steps: Enter your current password and the new one twice, then select [[Change Password]]. You stay signed in on this browser.

tasks.title: Add a password to an account without one
steps: Select [[Set password]], type the new password twice and select [[Set Password]].

good_to_know: Your password is never shown here, only whether it is set.
Changing your password signs out other browsers and devices that used the old one.
Your laboratory roles, client access and two-factor authentication stay as they were.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Requires a signed-in account and shows only that account. Reached from Password in the account menu. A shared demonstration account cannot open it: it returns to the home page with a notice.

items.label: State
items.description: Set when the account has a usable password; Not set when it signs in another way and has none yet.

items.label: Change password
items.description: Shown when a password is set. Opens Change password in the shared form dialog over this page. Success returns here with a success message.

items.label: Set password
items.description: Shown when no password is set. Opens Set password in the shared form dialog over this page. Success returns here with a success message.
